neighbours.label: The token ' lenses' in 'contact lenses' (the eyewear), not lenses of other kinds and not 'contact' in other senses
fire: After the eye exam he decided to try contact lenses for the first time.
My sister keeps a spare pair of contact lenses in her gym bag.
You should never sleep in your contact lenses unless the optician allows it.
The pharmacy sells saline solution for cleaning contact lenses.
Swimmers are advised to remove their contact lenses before entering the pool.
Daily disposable contact lenses cost more but are easier to care for.
He lost one of his contact lenses on the bathroom floor this morning.
Coloured contact lenses were part of her costume for the play.
quiet: After the eye exam he decided to try reading glasses for the first time.
My sister keeps a spare pair of telephoto lenses in her camera bag.
You should never contact the supplier directly unless the manager allows it.
The pharmacy sells saline solution for cleaning small wounds.
Swimmers are advised to avoid contact with jellyfish near the pier.
Scratched microscope lenses cost a lot and are hard to replace.
He lost his emergency contact card on the bathroom floor this morning.
Tinted sunglasses were part of her costume for the play.

notes: Card: top examples all 'contact⟦ lenses⟧' (also Russian 'контактные лин⟦зы⟧'). Probes: contact lenses 0.77, camera lenses 0.05, 'contact the office' 0.05.
